body: NO AUTHORIZED LOCAL COPY. Measured 01:0x: a name search of [private path], [private path], [private path] and [private path] finds no SBKF archive, TA01_cmm.dat, TA01_dimp.F, ta1_ax12p.inp or cmm.dat. It finds only the monograph itself (research/papers/hilburger-2023-buckling-cylinders.pdf, NASA/SP-8007-2020/REV 2, with its working copies) and [private path], a drafted question to Dr Hilburger about the knockdown on a thin laminate strut. Nothing shows it was sent. I did not search the full RideRC HDDs. AN ARCHIVE REQUEST to NASA Langley is an outward act, so it is the Admiral's to send, through the Desk. RULING: the redirect asks for 'a Hilburger 2023 case', not TA01. Pick a case from that monograph whose geometry, material, boundary conditions and published buckling value are printed in it or in an openly published companion, so the benchmark needs no archive. That choice is yours and changes no scope. TA01 stays a SOURCE_BLOCKER, not a FAIL. If you judge TA01 indispensable, say so with the reason, and I take a data request to the Desk for his decision; Communications would draft it and he would send it.
